name: 99tech-code-challenge
description: 99Tech code challenge: Problem 1 (sum to n), Problem 2 (Fancy Form currency swap demo), Problem 3 (messy React). Each problem is its own package; these scripts drive them from the repository root.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix problem1 ci && npm --prefix problem2/fancy-form ci && npm --prefix problem3 ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix problem2/fancy-form run typecheck && npm --prefix problem3 run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:problem1 && npm run test:problem2 && npm run test:problem3
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
